entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese packing context, all eleven turns and five hints against all twelve locales; checked bagged books, clothing gap filling, tracking and sender/recipient details.
Read police consultation context and all twelve complete target sets; checked three messages since morning, no reply/payment/link use, preservation of originals and no categorical fraud finding.

Compared all twelve locales with complete Japanese symptom-intake dialogue and hints; retained sensation, right knee, three-day onset, descending-stair aggravation and request for slower explanations.

Read complete Japanese certificate context and all twelve locale sets; checked fictional partial-household option, younger brother, one personal copy, omission of relationship field and current address.

Read all Japanese route metadata, eleven turns and five hints and twelve locale sets; checked two-minute concern, earlier 13:10 departure, twelve-minute transfer, unchanged 14:20 arrival and Aoba local only.
Read full park context and all twelve target sets; verified closed lawn entrance, paved outer path right, red drinking fountain landmark, gentle descent, blocked opposite side and same-route return.
Compared twelve complete locale sets and hints to detergent metadata and eleven Japanese turns; checked 400 ml at 200 yen versus 800 ml at 360 yen, same fragrance, two refills and reclosable pouch.

Read full bankbook rollover dialogue in Japanese and all twelve target sets; checked previous balance carryover, retention of old transactions, mark old cover only, preserve new machine-readable area, return both books.

Read complete Japanese envelope purchase scenario and all twelve locales including five hints each; verified unfolded A4, ten sheets, thicker envelope at 80 yen, address and enclosure before weighing, 200 yen postage after sealing.

Read full found-keys context and all twelve target sets; checked three keys on blue ring, station crossing around 11 am, right pavement viewed from station, no prior contacts and receipt-number enquiries.

changes.before: Ghi nhận và gửi trên phiếu này. Trước đóng cũng kiểm không lẫn đồ không gửi.
changes.after: Xin điền thông tin người nhận và người gửi vào phiếu gửi hàng này. Trước khi dán kín hộp, anh/chị cũng hãy kiểm tra xem có lẫn đồ không định gửi hay không.
changes.reason: Restore explicit sender and recipient roles lost in shorthand.

changes.before: हो, बाकस अलिक सार्दा पनि किताब नसरोस्, छेउ मेचमा गर्नुहोस्।
changes.after: हो, बाकसलाई हल्का हल्लाउँदा पनि किताब नसर्ने गरी राख्नुहोस्। छेउको टेबलमा मिलाउन सक्नुहुन्छ।
changes.reason: Clarify gentle box movement and packing table rather than chair.

changes.before: हो, मेच चलाउनुहोस्, धन्यवाद।
changes.after: हजुर, टेबल प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। धन्यवाद।
changes.reason: Use unambiguous table term in packing-table context.

changes.before: বলবেন, তিনটিই আছে পরেরও দেখাব।
changes.after: দয়া করে দেখুন। তিনটি বার্তাই রেখে দিয়েছি, তাই বাকিগুলোও দেখাচ্ছি।
changes.reason: Replace request to speak with request to inspect saved messages.

changes.before: Ghi lo đó. Đừng dùng liên kết hoặc số trong tin, hãy xem ghi hiện có.
changes.after: Tôi cũng sẽ ghi lại điều anh/chị lo lắng. Đừng dùng liên kết hoặc số điện thoại trong tin nhắn; chúng ta hãy kiểm tra các thông tin hiện có ở đây.
changes.reason: Restore clear instruction and phone-number referent from compressed text.

changes.before: डॉक्टर देंगे, प्रतीक्षालय रुकें।
changes.after: यह फॉर्म डॉक्टर को दे दूँगा। कृपया प्रतीक्षालय में इंतज़ार करें।
changes.reason: Restore object of handover and explicit waiting instruction.

changes.before: ให้แพทย์ค่ะ รอห้องพักนะคะ
changes.after: จะส่งแบบสอบถามอาการนี้ให้แพทย์ค่ะ กรุณารอที่ห้องรอนะคะ
changes.reason: Use waiting room rather than rest room for clinical waiting area.

changes.before: Bằng lái này. Xin một bản bản thân không quan hệ.
changes.after: Đây là bằng lái xe của tôi. Tôi xin cấp một bản sao phiếu cư trú chỉ có thông tin của tôi, không ghi mục quan hệ với chủ hộ.
changes.reason: Clarify omitted relationship field rather than person without relationships.

changes.before: 驾照这张，申请本人一份无关系。
changes.after: 这是我的驾照。我申请一份只记载我本人信息、不记载与户主关系的住民票副本。
changes.reason: Specify documentary omission instead of ambiguous no relationship.

changes.before: 駕照這張，申請本人一份無關係。
changes.after: 這是我的駕照。我申請一份只記載我本人資料、不記載與戶長關係的住民票副本。
changes.reason: Specify documentary omission instead of ambiguous no relationship.

changes.before: สิบสามสิบ ที่ต่อมีราวสิบสองนาทีค่ะ
changes.after: ออกเวลา 13:10 น. ค่ะ ที่สถานีเปลี่ยนขบวนจะมีเวลาประมาณสิบสองนาที
changes.reason: Disambiguate departure clock time from compressed concatenated numerals.

changes.before: หลังต่อคันเดิม จึงสิบสี่ยี่สิบเหมือนเดิมค่ะ
changes.after: หลังเปลี่ยนขบวนจะเป็นรถไฟขบวนเดิมค่ะ จึงถึงเวลา 14:20 น. เหมือนเดิม
changes.reason: Disambiguate unchanged arrival clock time and connecting train.

changes.before: สิบสามสิบ ต่อธรรมดาอาโอบะค่ะ ขอบคุณ
changes.after: จะออกเวลา 13:10 น. แล้วเปลี่ยนไปขึ้นรถไฟธรรมดาที่ไปสถานีอาโอบะค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
changes.reason: Restore clear departure time and connecting local destination.

changes.before: 红饮水处后有下池岔路。
changes.after: 经过红色饮水处后，会有一条下坡通往池边的岔路。
changes.reason: Clarify path leads toward pond rather than descending into water.

changes.before: 紅飲水處後有下池岔路。
changes.after: 經過紅色飲水處後，會有一條下坡通往池邊的岔路。
changes.reason: Clarify path leads toward pond rather than descending into water.

changes.before: 八百三百六十啊，拿这袋去收银。
changes.after: 八百毫升装是三百六十日元，对吧？我把这袋拿到收银台去。
changes.reason: Separate volume and currency instead of ambiguous adjacent numbers.

changes.before: 八百三百六十啊，拿這袋去收銀。
changes.after: 八百毫升裝是三百六十日圓，對吧？我把這袋拿到收銀台去。
changes.reason: Separate volume and currency instead of ambiguous adjacent numbers.

changes.before: แปดร้อยสามร้อยหกสิบนะคะ จะนำไปแคชเชียร์ค่ะ
changes.after: แปดร้อยมิลลิลิตร ราคาสามร้อยหกสิบเยนใช่ไหมคะ จะนำถุงนี้ไปที่แคชเชียร์ค่ะ
changes.reason: Restore units and currency to distinguish quantity from price.

changes.before: បាទ/ចាស សមតុល្យដដែលត្រូវបានផ្ទេរបន្តមកសៀវភៅថ្មី។ ចាប់ពីពេលនេះ សូមប្រើសៀវភៅថ្មីសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ពប្រតិបត្តិការចូល។
changes.after: បាទ/ចាស សមតុល្យដដែលត្រូវបានផ្ទេរបន្តមកសៀវភៅថ្មី។ ចាប់ពីពេលនេះ សូមប្រើសៀវភៅថ្មីសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ពកំណត់ត្រាប្រតិបត្តិការ។
changes.reason: Remove incoming-only restriction from future transaction updates.

changes.before: बाक्लो असी येन, ठेगाना लेख्ने मेच उता।
changes.after: बाक्लो खामको मूल्य असी येन हो। ठेगाना लेख्ने टेबल उता छ।
changes.reason: Use unambiguous writing table rather than chair.

changes.before: খাম দিয়ে ঠিকানা-ভেতর তৈরি করে ফেরা নিশ্চিত করুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.after: খামের দাম দিন এবং নাম-ঠিকানা লিখে কাগজপত্র ভরে ফিরে আসার ধাপটি নিশ্চিত করুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.reason: Restore paying for envelope rather than giving the envelope.

changes.before: ဘယ်သူမဆက်ဘဲရဲစခန်းလာယူကြောင်း ဂျပန်လိုပြောပါ။
changes.after: ဘယ်သူ့ကိုမှ မဆက်သွယ်ဘဲ သော့တွေကို ရဲစခန်းသို့ ယူလာခဲ့ကြောင်း ဂျပန်လိုပြောပါ။
changes.reason: Clarify bringing keys to police rather than coming to collect them.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
